The [[River Drake]] is the first [[dragon]] creature Tyrian characters can find. It is a good source of [[XP]] for lower level characters, as it is higher level than most [[Pre-Searing]] mobs. It is easier to tackle with a spellcaster due to [[Blurred Vision]], but can also be dealt with by [[melee]] classes due to their higher [[armor rating]].
